hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE '(^|[;&|]\s*)(sudo\s+)?rm\s' && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|\s)-[a-zA-Z]*[rR]|--recursive' && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|\s)-[a-zA-Z]*[fF]|--force'; then echo 'BLOCKED by production-safety: rm with recursive+force. Use trash or rm -r without -f.' >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE '\b(DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA)|TRUNCATE\s|DELETE\s+FROM|ALTER\s+TABLE|FLUSH(ALL|DB))\b'; then jq -cn --arg r 'production-safety: destructive SQL/redis statement — confirm env + target + rollback' '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'; fi; exit 0
